name: 流程协同后台
positioning: 适合事项流转、节点督办、风险处置和高密度运营台账类网页 Demo

runtime.platform: modern web browsers with responsive wide and narrow layouts

design_tokens.font_family: system sans-serif with Chinese platform fonts
design_tokens.shadow_style: flat compact panels with thin borders and almost no shadow

layout_rules: Use a deep navy sidebar and a compact two-row top context bar on wide web layouts.
Use square, thin-bordered panels with teal title rules and dense operational tables.
Map each visible sidebar item to one complete mutually exclusive page view.
Use compact KPI tiles, a node-throughput chart, a timeline, and an activity stream rather than decorative hero art.
Open record details in a right drawer and confirm workflow progression before mutating state.
Below 900px, present the same web navigation as an off-canvas sidebar with a page overlay.

component_inventory.name: compact_metric
component_inventory.use_for: live counts derived from workflow records

component_inventory.name: confirmation_dialog
component_inventory.use_for: confirmed workflow mutation and member invitation

interaction_contracts: Navigation updates aria-current, breadcrumb, document title, hash, focus, and visible page while preserving page-local form state.
Period controls recalculate the displayed throughput values and labels from local mock state.
Ledger filters and reset update rows, totals, and a truthful empty state.
CSV export creates a nonempty file from the current filtered ledger.
Every record action opens the correct drawer; confirmed progression updates the ledger, overview, node board, notifications, and activity history.
Invite validates required fields before adding a member and recalculating team load.
Settings save current demo preferences and restore the packaged defaults.
Drawer and dialogs support explicit close, cancel, Escape, focus containment, and focus restoration.
All visible enabled controls have an observable result and all state labels include text.

preserve: deep navy navigation with teal active accents
high information density and compact 32px controls
square thin-bordered panels and teal title rules
operational tables, node counts, timelines, and activity streams
restrained shadows and gray-white work canvas
replace_from_development_document: product name, page names, record noun, fields, filters, and columns
workflow statuses, transitions, validation, permissions, and confirmation copy
metrics, chart data, notifications, activity entries, members, and settings
avoid: Gentelella logos, screenshots, brand copy, images, icons, or upstream source code
consumer-style oversized cards, heavy gradients, or pill-shaped controls
native desktop chrome, scrolling between top-level pages, or fake enabled controls

single_file_compilation.style_source: inline tokens.css into a style element
single_file_compilation.script_source: inline interactions.js before the closing body tag
single_file_compilation.asset_policy: inline SVG and CSS shapes only; no external URLs
